text:
Sam W: Quick question — two items from my trip to Berlin last week: 1) I lost the taxi receipt for the ride from Tegel to the hotel (late night). Card shows the charge but I don’t have a paper receipt. 2) I shipped a small booth crate home using my personal card after the event because logistics screwed up. How do I file these?

Priya (People Ops): For the lost taxi receipt we accept a Lost Receipt Attestation + a copy of the card/bank statement showing the charge. Fill out the attestation form (linked below), include the date/time, origin/destination, and approximate fare. We also like a screenshot of the route in Maps if you still have it. :+1:

people_ops_bot: People Ops Lost Receipt Attestation: https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/lost-receipt (use Job code: TRAVEL-LOST-2026)

Sam W: Cool — the card shows a EUR 38.40 charge on 2026-03-10. I’ll attach the bank PDF. For the crate: my manager okayed shipping but vendor didn’t have FedEx account; I used my Amex. Tracking and shipping invoice are in my email but I didn’t get a company PO.

Priya (People Ops): Shipping is reimbursable if pre-approved by manager — sounds like you have that. We need: 1) shipping invoice/receipt, 2) tracking number screenshot, 3) the manager approval (Slack thread or email) attached. If you paid on a personal card, file as an expense and choose "Employee-paid vendor" in the form. Currency: submit in EUR and our system will convert using the bank rate on the transaction date.

Jonas: Quick add on per-diem — Sam, was the day you shipped the crate a company travel day or a personal extension? Per-diem rules differ if you had a personal day in between.

Sam W: That day was a travel day home (flight midday) but I extended personal evening to help pack. I already claimed full day per-diem for that date.

Priya (People Ops): If any part of a calendar day is personal (not business), per-diem should be pro-rated. For partial travel days we usually allow the travel per-diem but not the full daily allowance if significant personal time was used. Please flag it on the expense as "partial day" and add a short note. We'll review and adjust if needed.

Sam W: One more — there was one dinner where alcohol was part of the tab and I used team card. Is that reimbursable? It was mostly client-facing but a few beers were personal.

Priya (People Ops): If it’s client entertainment and pre-approved as a meal with clients, we can reimburse alcohol within reason; we ask you to itemize the receipt and mark which lines are business vs personal. If it’s mixed and not client facing, we’ll split and the personal portion is non-reimbursable. Please submit the itemized receipt and a brief note about attendees.

Sam W: Got it — I’ll submit the lost receipt attestation, bank PDF, shipping invoice + manager approval, update per-diem note, and itemize the dinner. Anything else?

Priya (People Ops): That should be everything. Once you submit, tag me and I’ll expedite review. If anything is missing we’ll ping you for a follow-up. Thanks for keeping receipts and threads — makes audits easier. :smile:

people_ops_bot: Reminder: Expense reports older than 60 days may need exec approval for exceptions.

Sam W: Thanks all — filing now.
